observation_summary: Entity graph run: 5 filings, 119 directors, 1 proposal, 87 signals. All 4 tickers (AAPL, BAC, AMZN, BEN) had governance_health_index score=0 (critical). Only 1 of 5 proxy filings yielded non-director proposals (20% yield). gaps field was null despite the low proposal yield.
actions_taken:
Root cause analysis: signals.ndjson is append-only and entity-graph batches write the same logical signals on every run (same signal_id). Over 5+ runs, 6 AMZN long-tenure directors accumulated 30+ signals, causing ScoreGovernanceHealth to apply the penalty 30x rather than 6x, driving health scores to 0.

1. Added DeduplicateSignals([]Signal) []Signal to graph.go: keeps only the most recently-detected signal per signal_id. Signals with empty SignalID pass through unchanged.

2. Called DeduplicateSignals on historicalSignals after LoadSignals in cmd/entity-graph/main.go, with explanatory comment.

3. Reduced director_long_tenure penalty in DefaultGovernanceHealthPenalties from 0.06 to 0.03. Even after dedup, companies with 12+ long-tenure directors (BEN/Franklin Resources) would have 12 x 0.06 = 0.72 in penalties — disproportionate for a low-severity, low-confidence signal.

4. Fixed detectGaps in observer.go: added processed int parameter to the function signature, updated the call site in BuildObservation, and added a secondary gap check for low proposal yield (< 50% of processed proxy filings yielded proposals when processed >= 2). This makes partially-broken proposal parsing visible to the RSI loop.

5. Added 3 tests to signals_test.go: TestDeduplicateSignals_KeepsMostRecent (basic dedup behavior), TestDeduplicateSignals_PreservesEmptyID (empty-ID passthrough), TestDeduplicateSignals_PreventsHealthSaturation (regression test showing dedup raises health score above 0 for long-tenure-heavy boards).

All tests pass (go test ./...).
notes: The 1-of-5 proposal yield gap will now be surfaced in future observations. Without access to the actual filing texts being processed, a specific parser fix for the missing 4 filings' format cannot be made — the gap detection improvement will identify this in the next run. The governance health saturation fix (deduplication) is the highest-impact change and addresses the systematic issue across all tickers.
